title: Abstract pullback assembly for pairings with a partial tensorator
statement: Let C,E,D,F be monoidal categories, S:C to D, Sprime:E to F, U:C to E, and V:D to F functors, and gamma:S composed V to U composed Sprime a natural transformation. Let P,Pprime be predicates with U carrying P to Pprime, and mu,muprime tensor comparisons on their left P/Pprime factors, with muprime natural. Fix ordinary comparison delta:U(L tensor M) to U(L) tensor U(M), and comparison kappa:V(SL tensor SM) to V(SL) tensor V(SM). If the canonical mu/muprime square with gamma,delta,kappa commutes, then the corresponding square for arbitrary pairings f,g and arrows b,c,d commutes whenever U(f);d=delta;(b tensor c);g. No exactness or invertibility is assumed.

source.place: Tag 06YU, functorial coherence of tensor pairings; elementary categorical assembly of the canonical comparison squares.

proof.text: Use gamma naturality on f. Apply Sprime to the ordinary pullback square, and replace its initial comparison by the assumed canonical tensorator square. Naturality of muprime moves b tensor c to the tensor factors. Tensor bifunctoriality combines these maps with the two gamma components.

theorem flatPairing_pullback_assembly
    {C : Type uC} {E : Type uE} {D : Type uD} {F : Type uF}
    [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vE} E] [Category.{vD} D] [Category.{vF} F]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory E]
    [MonoidalCategory D] [MonoidalCategory F]
    (S : C ⥤ D) (S' : E ⥤ F) (U : C ⥤ E) (V : D ⥤ F)
    (γ : S ⋙ V ⟶ U ⋙ S') (P : C → Prop) (P' : E → Prop)
    (μ : ∀ L M : C, P L → (S.obj L ⊗ S.obj M ⟶ S.obj (L ⊗ M)))
    (μ' : ∀ L M : E, P' L → (S'.obj L ⊗ S'.obj M ⟶ S'.obj (L ⊗ M)))
    (δ : ∀ L M : C, U.obj (L ⊗ M) ⟶ U.obj L ⊗ U.obj M)
    (κ : ∀ L M : C,
      V.obj (S.obj L ⊗ S.obj M) ⟶ V.obj (S.obj L) ⊗ V.obj (S.obj M))
    (hU : ∀ {L : C}, P L → P' (U.obj L))
    (h_natural : ∀ {L L' M M' : E} (b : L ⟶ L') (c : M ⟶ M')
      (hL : P' L) (hL' : P' L'),
      (S'.map b ⊗ₘ S'.map c) ≫ μ' L' M' hL' = μ' L M hL ≫ S'.map (b ⊗ₘ c))
    (h_pull : ∀ (L M : C) (hL : P L),
      V.map (μ L M hL) ≫ γ.app (L ⊗ M) ≫ S'.map (δ L M) =
        κ L M ≫ (γ.app L ⊗ₘ γ.app M) ≫ μ' (U.obj L) (U.obj M) (hU hL))
    {L M N : C} {L' M' N' : E} (hL : P L) (hL' : P' L')
    (f : L ⊗ M ⟶ N) (g : L' ⊗ M' ⟶ N')
    (b : U.obj L ⟶ L') (c : U.obj M ⟶ M') (d : U.obj N ⟶ N')
    (w : U.map f ≫ d = δ L M ≫ (b ⊗ₘ c) ≫ g) :
    V.map (μ L M hL ≫ S.map f) ≫ γ.app N ≫ S'.map d =
      κ L M ≫ (γ.app L ≫ S'.map b) ▷ V.obj (S.obj M) ≫
        S'.obj L' ◁ (γ.app M ≫ S'.map c) ≫ (μ' L' M' hL' ≫ S'.map g)
